Through: Mr.Rishipal Singh,

Through: Ms.Nandita Rao, ASC  Peswani, Advoc  Dinesh, PS Nan  R2/complainant  CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE YOGESH KHANNA

Petitioners file this writ petition for quashing of the FIR No.710/2021 under Section 420/468/471/120B Indian Penal Code registered at police station Nangloi, Delhi against them and the proceedings emanating therefrom.

2. The case of the prosecution as contended by the complainant/ respondent No.2 was the petitioners had created the false chain of property documents concerning property bearing No.C-35Rajdhani Park, Delhi - 110041.
This was reported by the complainant to the police and such documents were sent to Department of Archives, GNCT of Delhi for verification.

entities.text: Department of Archives, GNCT of Delhi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The chain of property documents were found to be false as the documents were never a part of the Archives Department.
It is stated the petitioners have hatched the conspiracy to create the false property documents.
However, the matter has been amicably settled between the parties and both the petitioners have admitted the claim of respondent No.2 in the civil suit filed by the petitioners viz CS SCJ/1066/2021.
The petitioners have also withdrawn aforesaid suit and handed over the possession of subject property to the respondent No.2, who does not wish to pursue this case against the petitioners.
3. The complainant/respondent No.2 has been duly identified by the Investigating Officer, states the matter has been settled with the petitioners and he has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
The learned ASC for the State has also no objection, if this petition is allowed.
The affidavits of parties are on record.
There is no incriminating FSL result for forgery etc against the petitioners.

sentences.text: Considering the above settlement between the parties, there is no impediment in quashing of the FIR as complainant has settled all the disputes and has received the possession of the subject property from the petitioners.
In view of the above, there is no use to continue with the proceedings against petitioners as it would never entail in conviction of petitioners.
5. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, FIR No.710/2021 under Section 420/468/471/120B Indian Penal Code registered at police station Nangloi, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Pending application, if any, also stands disposed of.
No order as to costs.

YOGESH KHANNA, J.
